Game UI asset sheet, pixel art mouse cursors, cyberpunk techwear and 90s anime aesthetic, dark industrial metal textures. Set of compact, modern, minimalist cursors: 
1. Modern directional pointer: ultra-short, sleek angular arrow styled like a tactical micro-boomerang with sharp clean edges and high-contrast styling.
2. Companion tech accents: minimalist pixel art cursor variations with sharp geometry, cyan or amber indicators, designed for clean high-density browser game HUD control.

Consistent 2D pixel art style, isolated grid layout, dark sci-fi urban atmosphere, crisp details, professional game UI asset sheet.
